items.source: Dispatching Enhancer callback. This is identical to the LazyLoader interface but needs to be separate so that Enhancer knows which type of code to generate.
items.translation: 分发 `Enhancer` 回调。这与 `LazyLoader` 接口相同，但需要单独定义，以便 `Enhancer` 知道要生成哪种类型的代码。

items.source: Return the object which the original method invocation should be dispatched. This method is called for every method invocation.
items.translation: 返回原始方法调用应调度的对象。此方法针对每个方法调用被调用。

items.source: an object that can invoke the method
items.translation: 一个可以调用该方法的对象
